cards.claim: Lien Verburgt-Kramers has been listed on the focus list for the NL Gendergap maintenance project.
cards.quote: In a significant step towards promoting gender equality, the Wikimedia project NL Gendergap maintenance has added Dutch watercolorist Lien Verburgt-Kramers to its focus list.

cards.claim: Lien Verburgt-Kramers has been listed on the focus list for WikiProject Badminton/tournament.
cards.quote: In a surprising turn of events, the Wikimedia project WikiProject Badminton\/tournament focus list has added an unlikely name to its roster: Lien Verburgt-Kramers, a renowned Dutch watercolorist from the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
